purpose: Record a professional pre-Human review of the ten Core5 editable setting-board specs. This layer may detect structural blockers and revision needs, but it cannot create Human approval, Master approval, raster authority or image-generation authorization.
globalFindings: All ten specs preserve the distinction between editable reference planning and Story/Character Canon.
All four non-Yui Core5 eras keep exact year OPEN; Yui alone retains 2026_CURRENT.
All five population/household boards explicitly deny creation of literal Character family canon.
Era readability is carried by access, communication, transport, repair, records, provisioning, maintenance and friction rather than costume-only shorthand.
No spec authorizes raster generation, Master promotion or runtime promotion.
The next visual-reference evidence phase must keep panel labels/source/open boundaries visible and must not convert composite population lenses into literal relatives.

strengths: repair/reuse/records/infrastructure are readable together
poverty cosplay and universal deprivation are explicitly vetoed
exact year/site/product/vehicle/fixture remain OPEN
humanAttention: Confirm the reconstruction/scarcity band is narratively appropriate without narrowing to one real incident or locality.

strengths: development benefit and resident friction coexist
pollution/oil-shock material is bounded away from reenactment
old/new route and convenience systems can be compared visually
humanAttention: Confirm the selected era band is the intended breadth before any specific development district or equipment is admitted.

strengths: online/offline coexistence is explicit
shared-PC/privacy/reply-delay friction gives era logic beyond props
modern smartphone/social-feed leakage is vetoed
humanAttention: When exact year is later fixed, re-check PHS/feature-phone/BBS/broadband combinations for temporal compatibility.

strengths: 2026_CURRENT and Arakawa are preserved as decided authority
present day is not reduced to smartphone-only shorthand
privacy-safe locality boundary is explicit
humanAttention: Any recognizable street/business/private-resident reference still requires separate locality/privacy review.

strengths: future design is function-first rather than neon/chrome shorthand
trajectory research is explicitly non-prophetic
identity/access/maintenance/mobility provide reusable design questions
humanAttention: Do not promote candidate future infrastructure into fact until Story authority decides the exact society/legal/technology layer.

strengths: six population lenses are present
household variation is based on access/repair/distribution rather than gender roles
literal Tomori family canon is explicitly denied
humanAttention: Visual evidence should differentiate the six lenses through task/access relationships, not age costume caricature.

strengths: new infrastructure benefit and environmental/price friction can coexist
mobility and ability-to-relocate differences create meaningful household variation
literal family inference is blocked
humanAttention: Avoid making environmental exposure a personality or moral shorthand when visual evidence is authored.

strengths: shared/private device access creates household-level era logic
cash/print/FAX/mobile/PC coexistence is reusable
literal family inference is blocked
humanAttention: Exact-year review must precede any precise device/network ownership depiction.

strengths: 2026 mixed access is represented across payment/device/local-delivery/mobility systems
older-adult access is not treated as a technology gag
literal Yui family/private address remain OPEN
humanAttention: Keep Arakawa-specific texture privacy-safe and avoid implying any composite household is Yui's actual household.

food/body/network/maintenance differences are non-hierarchical
literal Asa family/legal status/future society remain unresolved
